svg.title: The resulting plaquette is exactly exp z. At z = 0, the residual has the vanishing property (SQ7). Each ordered link derivative lowers this vanishing order by at most one: introduce one extra real variable for its left increment, apply the vanishing composition to the joint variables, and then differentiate in that variable at zero. Induction gives vanishing through order strictly below max(5 −q, 0) for Jq(A; eU(z)).
